html:
Given nonnegative rows and columns, return the rectangle border as a list of lines without trailing spaces. If either dimension is zero, return []. Thin rectangles are entirely filled.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3,
    5
  ],
  "expected": [
    "*****",
    "*   *",
    "*****"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    1,
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "***"
  ]
}
Hint

A border cell lies on an extreme row or column.

Complexity: O(rows*columns) characters of time and output
